data.name: Sealed Binding Script
data.description:
The air is wrong.

Not heavy, not silent—just wrong.

The ruins before you should feel abandoned. Ancient. Still. Instead, the embers still breathe within the cracks of the stone. The ritual here has already been disturbed, but the remnants still pulse, whispering their unfinished purpose into the air.

At the center, a scroll rests upon the altar, its surface burned at the edges but still intact. The Sealed Binding Script. Even without touching it, you can feel what it was meant to do.

It was never a tool. Never an ordinary relic.

It was a lock.

And now, it is one step closer to breaking.
